mgmt_bio.text: Zhang Yi is the chief executive of China Construction Bank, where he has served as president since May 2024, as executive director since June 2024 and as vice chairman of the board since July 2024. Since January 2025 he has concurrently served as chairman of Sino-German Bausparkasse. He fronts the bank's investor communications, leading the presentation of its 2026 interim results alongside other senior management.

sentences.quote: Mr. Zhang Yi has been the President and Vice Chairman of the bank since 2024. Previously, he served as Executive Vice President at the Bank of China between March 2023 and May 2024.
sentences.text: Senior leadership rotates frequently within the state system: Zhang Jinliang became chairman in March 2024 after serving as president from May 2022, while Zhang Yi, previously an executive vice president at Bank of China, has been president and vice chairman since 2024.
Execution has been steady rather than spectacular, with 2025 net profit of RMB 339.8 billion, up 1.04%, return on average equity of 10.04% and an NPL ratio of 1.31%.

sentences.quote: In 2025, CCB successfully completed the issuance of A-shares to China's Ministry of Finance, raising CNY 105 billion (approximately $15.2B), effectively replenishing its core tier 1 capital.
sentences.text: Capital allocation is conservative and partly state-directed: a RMB 105 billion A-share issue to the Ministry of Finance lifted the core tier 1 ratio to 14.63%, with the 2025 payout ratio at 30%.
